# TORQUE E - BIKES Australia

> Australia’s Home of High-Torque E-Motos, Performance Conversion Kits & Custom Upgrades

TORQUE E - BIKES is an authorised Australian retailer and specialist in high-performance electric motocross and MTB conversion systems. We bridge the gap between mountain biking and motocross.

Location: Brisbane City, QLD 4000, Australia
Contact: WhatsApp +61480804189, Email sales@torquee-bikesaustralia.com.au
Min Order: AUD 0
Free Shipping: Over AUD 199
Payment Methods: bank-transfer, payid, crypto-BTC, crypto-USDT
Crypto Discount: 5%

## Products
- [Complete E-Motos & Dirt Bikes](https://torquee-bikesaustralia.com.au/shop/complete-e-motos/): Ready-to-ride performance electric dirt bikes.
- [MTB Conversion Kits & Motors](https://torquee-bikesaustralia.com.au/shop/conversion-kits/): High-torque hub and mid-drive motor systems.
- [Batteries & Power Systems](https://torquee-bikesaustralia.com.au/shop/batteries/): High-capacity 52V and 72V lithium packs.
- [Parts, Drivetrain & Cockpit](https://torquee-bikesaustralia.com.au/shop/parts/): Brakes, chains, throttles and upgrades.
- [Protective Gear & Accessories](https://torquee-bikesaustralia.com.au/shop/gear/): Helmets, armour and hauler systems.
